import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--short"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("STATUS:", result.stdout)
result = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("LOG:", result.stdout)
result = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "base"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("DIFF:\n", result.stdout[:8000])
